strings.l1_lesson1_subtitle: What beads are & how to tap them
strings.l1_lesson2_subtitle: Move lower beads — count up to 4!
strings.l1_lesson1_step1_body: An abacus is a counting frame with beads on rods. People used it long before calculators existed!
strings.l1_lesson1_step2_body: The outer frame holds everything together. The horizontal bar in the middle is called the BEAM — it divides top from bottom!
strings.l1_lesson1_step3_body: Above the beam sits 1 special bead. Push it DOWN to touch the beam and it counts as FIVE! ✋
strings.l1_lesson1_step4_body: Below the beam are 4 beads. Each one you push UP to touch the beam counts as ONE! 1️⃣
strings.l1_lesson1_step5_body: Heaven bead down = 5. Count earth beads touching the beam. Add them! Here: heaven(5) + 3 earth = 8! 🌟
strings.l1_lesson2_step1_body: All beads away from the beam = ZERO. Nothing touching the beam = nothing to count!
strings.l1_lesson2_step2_body: Push exactly 1 earth bead UP to touch the beam. The rod now shows the number 1!
strings.l1_lesson2_step3_body: Push 2 earth beads UP. Count them: one... two! The rod shows 2! 🎊
strings.l1_lesson2_step4_body: Three earth beads touching the beam. Count: 1, 2, 3! The rod shows 3! 🌈
strings.l1_lesson2_step5_body: Push ALL 4 earth beads up to the beam! Count: 1, 2, 3, 4! Maximum using only earth beads!
strings.l1_lesson3_step1_body: Push the HEAVEN bead DOWN to touch the beam. Just that ONE bead = FIVE! It's a super shortcut! 🌟
strings.l1_lesson3_step2_body: Heaven bead down (=5) PLUS 1 earth bead up (=1). 5 + 1 = SIX! Adding magic! ✨
strings.l1_lesson3_step3_body: Heaven bead down (=5) + 2 earth beads up (=2). 5 + 2 = SEVEN! 🎯
strings.l1_lesson3_step4_body: Heaven bead down (=5) + 3 earth beads up (=3). 5 + 3 = EIGHT! Almost there! 🎈
strings.l1_lesson3_step5_body: Heaven bead down (=5) + 4 earth beads up (=4). 5 + 4 = NINE! That's the most 1 rod can show! 🏆
strings.l1_lesson4_step1_body: An abacus has many rods! The RIGHT rod shows ONES (1–9). The LEFT rod shows TENS (10, 20, ...)! 🎯
strings.l1_lesson4_step2_body: Push 1 earth bead up on the LEFT (tens) rod. The right rod stays at zero. One bead on the tens rod = TEN!
strings.l1_lesson4_step3_body: LEFT: 2 earth beads up = 2 tens = 20. RIGHT: 3 earth beads up = 3 ones. 20 + 3 = 23! 🌟
strings.l1_lesson4_step4_body: LEFT: heaven bead down = 5 tens = 50. RIGHT: heaven + 1 earth = 5+1 = 6 ones. 50 + 6 = 56! 🎊
strings.l1_lesson4_step5_body: Read LEFT rod first (tens × 10), then add RIGHT rod (ones). Here: 4 tens + 7 ones = 47! 🏆
strings.l1_lesson5_step1_body: With 2 rods you can show ANY number from 0 to 99! That's 100 different numbers you can read! 🎉
strings.l1_lesson5_step2_body: TENS rod: heaven(5) + 1 earth(1) = 6 tens = 60. ONES rod: heaven(5) + 2 earth(2) = 7. 60 + 7 = 67! 🎯
strings.l1_lesson5_step3_body: TENS rod: only the heaven bead down = 5 tens = 50. ONES rod: nothing = 0. Just one heaven bead = 50! 🌟
strings.l1_lesson5_step4_body: TENS: heaven(5)+4 earth = 9 tens = 90. ONES: heaven(5)+4 earth = 9 ones. 90+9 = 99! The max! 🌈
strings.l1_lesson5_step5_body: Read the LEFT rod (×10) then add the RIGHT rod. What's below? Left=3, Right=8 → 38! You did it! 🌈
